refinements.prompt: Revise this sprite source sheet AGAIN for genuinely tiny 32x30-pixel game sprites. The previous version still has far too much detail and fails when reduced. Keep exactly the same 12 original monsters and exact 6x2 positions. Keep black background. Render every monster as VERY COARSE low-resolution pixel art with ONLY about 24-32 chunky square pixels across the entire creature and 26-30 chunky pixels tall, enlarged with nearest neighbor. Each visible pixel block should be roughly 8-12 image pixels wide. This is authentic tiny sprite art, NOT a detailed illustration with pixelated edges. All eyes must be large solid 2x2 logical-pixel blocks, faces must occupy at least 5x5 logical pixels, ring cores at least 5x5 logical pixels with bright yellow centers, green screens at least 5x4 logical pixels with separate eyes. Reduce canopy leaves to 3-5 large clumps, branches to 3-4 thick antlers, armor to 4-6 broad plates. Use only 8-12 flat colors per monster, with 3 clearly separated lightness bands. No anti-aliasing, no fine texture, no small outlines, no glow, no subpixel detail, no intricate seams. Preserve recognizability of all designs and their color families. Each sprite must be instantly legible at 32x30 actual pixels. KEEP same row-major ordering.

Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is only a STYLE REFERENCE for coarse pixels, do NOT copy its monsters. Revise image 1 for genuinely tiny 32x30-pixel terminal sprites. Preserve all monsters, identities, poses, palettes and EXACT original grid positions. Pure black background, no labels. Each creature must be made of only about 24-32 chunky logical pixels across and 26-30 tall, visibly enlarged nearest-neighbor, matching image 2's coarse scale. NOT a detailed illustration with pixelated outlines. Use 8-12 flat colors per creature and three strong lightness bands. Faces at least 5x5 logical pixels, bright eyes 2x2 pixels, muzzles/jaws clearly separated. Large glowing cores 4-5 pixels wide. Consolidate armor/circuitry into few broad plates and marks, fins into few broad separate shapes, mist/leaves into broad clumps. Preserve limb gaps and tails. No fine texture, thin outlines, dithering, gradients, glow blur or subpixel details.

refinements.prompt: Edit ONLY the TOP ROW SECOND monster (green bloatmass slime) in this source sheet. Do not add eyes to vents or anywhere on its body; the two eyes must read as one face above the mouth. No other changes.

Edit ONLY the green slime monster in the TOP ROW, SECOND COLUMN of this sheet. Its face needs to survive at 32x30 pixels. Give it an enormous simple BLACK open mouth, a horizontal oval/rectangle occupying 45 percent of the creature width and 20 percent of its height, placed directly below the existing two bright yellow eyes. Keep only two chunky cream teeth at the upper edge of that mouth. Remove the green chin/face shading and vents directly around the mouth so it is one clean solid black opening, not a thin slit. Keep the two yellow eyes large and separate above it. Preserve mound silhouette and gray vents around the outer body. Maintain coarse pixel-art style, no gradients. Keep other 11 monsters unchanged, same 6x2 grid and pure black background.
